sources.title: GLiNER2.5: Open-Source Information Extraction Model
sources.snippet: GLiNER2.5 replaces span enumeration with a new boundary-prediction architecture, unlocking unlimited span length, long-context extraction, joint entity-relation extraction, constrained classification, and span attributes.
